adaptation: SoftFloat retained arithmetic and explicit binary64 stores. Complete infinite/Fourier algorithms; reflection and layered callbacks, legacy complex sqrt/exp/sinh/cosh/tanh, wide native-Pi trig and physical scaling; square assembly and segment folding, including zero-term stamps and via traversal. Imported binary64 sin/cos follow the observed glibc 2.39 implementation, kept separate from native FSIN/FCOS. Observer callbacks retain portable Python. Original/legacy-DSO and complete actual-session gates record scoped exact boundaries; raw native instruction differences remain explicit strict diagnostics. Source provenance and license for the imported-math adaptation are in glibc/source.json and glibc/COPYING.LIB.
